answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a bonded stake registry keyed to a provable identity anchor. Every agent must post a bond before transacting, and each bond locks to one verified root: a hardware key plus a grove of attestations from already-bonded peers. A newcomer cannot borrow that grove, so a thousand fake agents require a thousand separate bonds and proofs. If a dispute lands on the fault ledge, the vouching peers are slashed with the offender, making collusion cost more than it earns.
